objects.description: Pseudorandom number generator implementing xoroshiro128++ with 128-bit state, providing 64-bit outputs and range helpers. Constructible with optional seed; exposes state getters/setters.
Internal 128-bit state for XorShift128PlusPlus consisting of two 64-bit words. Typically owned by XorShift128PlusPlus; external code may read/modify via accessors.

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::GetInitialState
functions.description: Returns a deterministically initialized internal PRNG state derived from the given 64-bit seed using SplitMix64. Typical usage: pass the returned State to initialize or reinitialize an instance or for reproducible streams.
requirements: seed: any 64-bit unsigned value is accepted; no special constraints are documented.

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::XorShift128PlusPlus
functions.description: Default-constructs the PRNG with a deterministic initial state equivalent to GetInitialState(0). Use when a fixed, reproducible sequence is acceptable.
requirements: May be used in constant-evaluated contexts (constexpr-capable construction).
Object must remain alive while any references/pointers obtained from it are used.

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::GetState
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the PRNG’s current internal state (two u64 words). Useful for snapshotting or external serialization without mutation.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid only while the XorShift128PlusPlus instance is alive and not moved/destroyed.
Caller must not attempt to modify the state through this const reference.

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::GetMutableStatePtr
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the PRNG’s mutable internal state, allowing direct state inspection or mutation by the caller.
requirements: The returned pointer becomes invalid when the XorShift128PlusPlus instance is destroyed or moved.
If the caller mutates the state, subsequent outputs will reflect those changes; no validation is performed by the class.
Caller is responsible for any required external synchronization; the class is not documented as thread-safe.

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::SetState
functions.description: Replaces the PRNG’s internal state with the provided State. Use to restore from a saved snapshot or to force a specific generator state.
requirements: state must be a valid XorShift128PlusPlus::State object; its contents are copied as-is; no validation is performed.
Avoid concurrent access from multiple threads while calling SetState (not documented as thread-safe).

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::Reset
functions.description: Reseeds the PRNG, replacing its internal state with GetInitialState(seed). Use to restart the sequence deterministically from a new or known seed.
requirements: seed: any 64-bit unsigned value is accepted; no special constraints are documented.
Avoid concurrent access from multiple threads while calling Reset (not documented as thread-safe).

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::Next
functions.description: Generates and returns the next 64-bit pseudorandom value from the xoroshiro128++ algorithm, updating internal state. Call repeatedly to get a stream of values.
requirements: No parameters; object must be initialized/constructed before use.
Avoid concurrent calls on the same instance without external synchronization; state updates are not documented as thread-safe.

functions.name: XorShift128PlusPlus::NextRange
functions.description: Returns a pseudorandom integer in [0, n) using rejection sampling to avoid modulo bias. Suitable for uniform bounded integers.
requirements: n must be greater than 0; passing n == 0 results in division by zero in the precomputed bound.
May loop internally until a value in range is produced; this is expected behavior for rejection sampling.
Avoid concurrent calls on the same instance without external synchronization.
